lockedFeatures: the continuous sweeping arc of the pocket mouth
the parallel topstitch line running the full length of the mouth
the downturn at the crease end of the arc
notes: Matches the illustration closely. The drawn open path is reproduced as an open path: a short vertical leg descending from the waistband at the hip, a rounded elbow, a long shallow sweep to the right, and a downturn into a short tail terminating at the front crease. The doubled line in the drawing is reproduced as a parallel topstitch. The separate horizontal coin-pocket welt right of the fly is present as drawn. Clearly distinguishable from its Square Jeans Pocket sibling, which is the discriminator that matters for this family.
